{{Quote|Nice uniform.''"<br />"''Thanks, but the collar's a little snug. Now I know why Imperials are so uptight.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and a disguised [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]]|<ref name="Drone Alone">{{SWComicCite|7.10|Drone Alone}}</ref>}}
The '''Imperial officer's uniform''' was the formal standard-issue dress worn by [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The uniform varied in [[Color/Legends|color]] depending on an individual's military branch affiliation. [[Officer/Legends|Officers]] wore [[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|rank insignia plaques]] and [[Imperial code cylinder]]s on their uniform to specify their [[Military rank/Legends|rank]]. The Imperial officer's uniform directly descended from the [[Republic military uniforms/Legends|uniform]] worn by [[Republic officer/Legends|Galactic Republic officers]].

==Description==
===Army and Naval officers===
*Gray-green double-breasted dress [[Imperial officer's tunic/Legends|tunic]] and trousers
*Corresponding cover with [[Officer's disk/Legends|Imperial officer's disc]]
*Corresponding Battle Dress (Armor, Helmet and black goggles with utility buckle, black belt and duty holster)
*Black leather belt with silver buckle
**Buckle contained secret data-storage compartment and officer's disc
*Black leather [[Durasteel-toed boots|boots]] ([[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]]-capped)
*Black leather [[Officer's gloves|gloves]] (optional)
*[[Rank insignia plaque/Legends|Rank badge]] on left breast
*[[Imperial code cylinder|Code cylinders]] located in pockets

===Officers in the Stormtrooper Corps/veteran TIE pilot/security officers===
*Black double-breasted dress tunic and trousers
*Corresponding headgear
*Black gauntlets (optional, as seen on Death Star)
*Rank badge on left breast (without armor, as seen on Death Star and with Snowtrooper armor, as seen during the Battle of Hoth)
*Black duty belt with silver buckle and utility boxes with optional duty holster
*Code cylinders located in pockets
*When not deployed in a hot zone, Stormtrooper officers were always in dress and never in armor

===Grand Admiral===
{{Main|Grand Admiral's uniform/Legends}}
*Spotless white double-breasted dress tunic and trousers
*Gold [[Epaulet/Legends|epaulets]]
*Black leather belt with silver buckle
*Black leather gloves
*Black leather boots
*Rank badge on left breast
*Code cylinders located in pockets
